name: coffee
description: Native macOS menu bar apps for keeping awake and tracking coding-agent usage

scripts.build: npm run build:coffee && npm run build:coffeeusage
scripts.run:coffee: npm run build:coffee && (pkill -x Coffee || true) && open Coffee/build/Coffee.app
scripts.run:coffeeusage: npm run build:coffeeusage && (pkill -x CoffeeUsage || true) && open CoffeeUsage/build/CoffeeUsage.app
scripts.install:coffeeusage: npm run build:coffeeusage && (pkill -x CoffeeUsage || true) && ditto CoffeeUsage/build/CoffeeUsage.app /Applications/CoffeeUsage.app && open /Applications/CoffeeUsage.app
